section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the aims and hypotheses of a single study examining relationships between multidimensional interoceptive awareness (measured by MAIA) and positive body image variables (body appreciation, body pride, functionality appreciation) as well as negative body image variables (overweight preoccupation, appearance orientation) in a large community sample of British women and men with a wide age range. The study seeks to address limitations in prior research by using a larger, more diverse sample and examining multiple dimensions of interoceptive awareness.
